beats.text: Kedarnath ki chadhai me woh ek mod aata hai jahan har yatri ruk kar sochta hai aage badhe ya nahi

Doston is yatra ki sabse pehli baat ye samajh lo ki Kedarnath sirf ek mandir nahi hai ye ek imtihaan hai tumhare sabr ka tumhari taiyari ka aur tumhare mann ki shanti ka jab tum Gaurikund se chalna shuru karte ho to pehle do kilometre aasan lagte hain lekin uske baad har kadam tumse ek sawaal poochta hai ki tum yahan kyun aaye ho kis ke liye aaye ho aur kya tum sach me andar se tayyar ho is pavitra safar ke liye ya bas bheed ke saath beh rahe ho
Raste me tumhe purane mandir aur chhoti dukaanen milengi jahan log chai peete hue apni kahaniyan sunate hain
Yahi woh hissa hai jahan aksar log jaldbazi me galti kar baithte hain aur baad me pachtate hain
Mandir parisar aur ghanti ki awaaz ka drishya
Ab woh baat jo sabse zyada kaam ki hai agar tum subah ki aarti me shamil hona chahte ho to samay ka khaas dhyan rakhna hoga
Is video ke sponsor ki taraf se ek chhota sa sandesh suniye
Lekin asli raaz abhi baki hai jo main video ke aakhir me bataunga woh ek chhota sa sanket hai mandir ke raaste par
Shaam ki aarti aur deep jalne ka drishya
To chalo ab usi raaz ki taraf badhte hain jiska intezaar tum shuru se kar rahe the dhyaan se sunna
Woh sanket hai ek purana patthar jahan Thakur ji ke charno ke nishan hain yahi is yatra ka asli pal hai
